title: Late Check-out Tariff of the Ashbury Brands (Guest Folios)
content:
Each Ashbury brand sets the terms on which a late check-out is charged to the Guest Folio: the grace period after the standard check-out time before any fee applies, the basis of the fee (a flat fee, or a share of the reservation's nightly rate), the latest check-out time charged at that fee, whether the fee bears room tax, and whether the brand honours the late check-out time an Ashbury Rewards elite tier guarantees.

## Tariff

| Brand | Grace after standard check-out | Fee basis | Flat fee | Share of nightly rate | Latest time charged at the fee | Fee bears room tax | Elite guaranteed late check-out honoured |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ashbury Express | 15 minutes | Flat fee | $30.00 | 0% | 14:00 | Yes | Yes |
| Ashbury Inn & Suites | 15 minutes | Flat fee | $35.00 | 0% | 14:00 | Yes | Yes |
| Ashbury Hotel | 30 minutes | Share of the nightly rate | $0.00 | 50% | 16:00 | Yes | Yes |
| Ashbury Grand | 30 minutes | Share of the nightly rate | $0.00 | 50% | 16:00 | Yes | Yes |
| Ashbury Resort & Spa | 30 minutes | Share of the nightly rate | $0.00 | 50% | 15:00 | Yes | No |
| Ashbury Reserve | 30 minutes | Share of the nightly rate | $0.00 | 50% | 16:00 | Yes | Yes |

Times are hotel local time; grace periods are in whole minutes.

## Reading the tariff

- The **flat fee** column applies only where the basis is a flat fee (Ashbury Express and Ashbury Inn & Suites); the **share of nightly rate** column applies only where the basis is a share of the nightly rate (the other four brands). The unused column of each brand shows $0.00 or 0%.
- The **latest time charged at the fee** is the last check-out time charged at the late check-out fee; a later departure is charged one full night of room and tax.
- **Elite guaranteed late check-out honoured** is "No" only at Ashbury Resort & Spa.

## Brand comparison in questions

**Which brands charge a flat late check-out fee, and how much?** Ashbury Express at $30.00 and Ashbury Inn & Suites at $35.00, each up to 14:00.

**What share of the nightly rate do the other brands charge?** 50% of the reservation's nightly rate, up to 16:00 at Ashbury Hotel, Ashbury Grand and Ashbury Reserve, and up to 15:00 at Ashbury Resort & Spa.

**Does tax apply to the late check-out fee?** Yes, at every brand the fee bears room tax.
